title: Simulation Before the Source Halts
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $x$ be a Boolean word, and let $c$ be a configuration of $M$ on input $x$. If the source run from $c$ is live at every time $j<t$, then after $t$ steps the right-boundary wrapper started from the embedding of $c$ equals the embedding of the source configuration reached after $t$ steps.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
$c$ is a configuration of $M$ on input $x
The source run from $c$ is live at every time $j<t$
replaced:
Let $c$ be a configuration of the source machine and $t$ a time before which the source
run from $c$ stays live. Then the right-boundary wrapper run for $t$ steps from the
embedding of $c$ equals the embedding of the source run at time $t$.
